staged_battery_activities.title: Bukhara Solar and Battery Energy Storage Project
descriptions: The Project constitutes the development, construction, operation, and transfer of a 250 MW solar PV along with a 63 MW/126MWh of battery storage and a 220 kV substation. The project site is in the Bukhara region and covers an area of around 6.75 square kilometers.
implementing_entities: Nur Bukhara Solar PV Foreign Enterprise LLC

staged_battery_activities.title: Nukus 2 Wind and Battery Energy Storage Project
descriptions: The project constitutes the development, construction, operation, and transfer of a 200-megawatt (MW) grid-connected wind power plant, a 100-megawatt-hour (MWh) battery energy storage system (BESS) and power evacuation infrastructure, comprised of a 220- kilovolt substation, an upgraded switchyard and Beruniy substation, and a 44-kilometer 110-kilovolt transmission line. It consists of 26 wind turbines, each with a capacity of 8 MW, a rotor diameter of 182 meters, and a hub height of 138 meters.
implementing_entities: ACWA Power Bash Wind Foreign Enterprise Limited Liability Company

staged_battery_activities.title: Guzar Solar and Battery Energy Storage Project
descriptions:
The project involves the design, construction, and operation of a 300 MW solar PV power plant, 75

MWh BESS, and their associated infrastructure in the Guzar district of Kashkadarya region of

Uzbekistan . This combination of solar energy and storage will provide clean energy

and improve power reliability in Uzbekistan by storing excess power during high production and

releasing it during peak demand.

staged_battery_activities.title: Solar Public-Private Partnership Investment Program - Tranche 2
descriptions: This Tranche 2 involves the issuance of a sovereign partial credit guarantee (PCG) under the Multitranche Financing Facility Number 113 Republic of Uzbekistan: Solar Public-Private Partnership Investment Program. The PCG will support the development of the Guzar Solar and BESS Project, which consists of a 300 MW solar photovoltaic (PV) power plant, a 75/megawatt/75 megawatt-hour battery energy storage system (BESS), and associated infrastructure in Guzar, Kashkadarya region. The PCG will enhance the creditworthiness of the electricity offtaker by backing a letter of credit issued in favor of the project company under the project's Public-Private Partnership Agreement (PPPA). The associated Guzar Solar and BESS project was designed and auctioned under the Uzbekistan Solar PPP Investment Program, which is primarily intended to catalyze the next stage of solar power market development in Uzbekistan.
implementing_entities: Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade (MIFT)
